name: rotate_realtime_secret
description:
Replaces the branch's Realtime shared secret and waits until the change is applied. NEVER run autonomously; always ask the user first. Call `get_realtime_secret` afterwards and update the application backend with the new value.

branch_id is a branch id (br-...), not a branch name. Call list_branches to resolve a name.

project_id.description: Required for an unscoped connection. May be omitted when the connection is scoped to one project; if provided, it must match that project.
